description: The person stores, tests and deletes their own provider keys and chooses how their runs route (L36 Y1/Y3): PUT/DELETE /api/v1/me/credentials/{provider}, POST /api/v1/me/credentials/{provider}/test and PUT /api/v1/me/ai/preferences. A key is tested on save (models, or a one-token request), sealed at rest and never returned, logged or put in an error. Only the person may call it — a service token or any token carrying on_behalf_of is refused, whatever capabilities it holds.
